selection: Whole v0.4.6 BangumiPlayerViewModel.kt, ui/player/BangumiPlayerFeatures.kt, policy/BangumiFollowStatusPolicy.kt and the upstream test BangumiFollowStatusPolicyTest.kt for roadmap slice bgm-player-viewmodel-and-features (part 1: view model, follow-session policy and feature state; the UI re-pin is a follow-up slice).
purpose: Advance the Windows PGC view model to the v0.4.6 blob (2bd981f7) inside the existing sole producer (tools/extract-upstream-bangumi-player.py), after its v034 initial-detail and audio-download layers: the follow-session convergence of 3b37b7a2 (v036), the like-status retry and mutex of 5a0bd7e2 (the v038 Bangumi hunks; d7ba1077 only changes ActionRepository and is not part of this slice), and the two methods of the 0.3.5 feature commit that the retained body never had, sendEpisodeDanmaku and saveCover. The 48 counted hunks below are the exact difference between the predecessor output (beforeFinalOutputs) and the advanced output; every line they add is upstream text except the sixteen windowsLines, which bind the new members to the Windows presenter environment. The follow-session policy and the v0.4.6 preload (targetSeasonId, sessionProvider, serialized background verification) are carried whole by the existing independent-pages producer (tools/v046_bangumi_player.py advance_follow_preload) because the view model calls it; the whole feature state file is emitted by the same producer as the view model with its Android settings, global repository and mute listener replaced by the desktop-owned DesktopOriginalBangumiSubtitlePort.

uiRetry.purpose: The carried v0.4.6 overlay shows the like icon as active only while likeStatusKnown is true and the retained Windows Bangumi UI bodies never passed it, so a liked episode would look unliked. Five counted pairs thread the flag exactly like upstream: 5a0bd7e2 (OverlayHost) and 763cf7b8 (Screen, Components).

private fun verifyPlaybackFollowStatus(detail: BangumiDetail) {
        val session = ensureFollowCacheSession()
        followVerificationJob?.cancel()
        val seasonId = detail.seasonId
        if (detail.seasonType == 10 || followStatusCache.containsKey(seasonId) ||
            followStatusValueCache.containsKey(seasonId) ||
            seasonId in followedSeasonIds || isBangumiFollowed(detail.userStatus)) return
        if (!environment.account.hasPrimarySessionCookie()) return
        followVerificationJob = environment.launch {
            if (!acceptsFollowSession(session)) return@launch
            val foundIds = mutableSetOf<Long>()
            val result = preloadFollowedSeasonsForType(
                type = defaultMyFollowTypeForSeasonType(detail.seasonType),
                followedSeasonIds = foundIds,
                targetSeasonId = seasonId,
                sessionProvider = environment.followSession,
                fetchPage = { requestedType, page, pageSize -> BangumiRepository.getMyFollowBangumi(requestedType, page, pageSize) }
            )
            kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
            if (!acceptsFollowSession(session)) return@launch
            val current = _uiState.value as? BangumiPlayerState.Success ?: return@launch
            if (current.seasonDetail.seasonId != seasonId || !result.requestSucceeded) return@launch
            followedSeasonIds.addAll(foundIds)
            if (seasonId !in foundIds) return@launch
            val verifiedStatus = if (!followStatusCache.containsKey(seasonId) &&
                !followStatusValueCache.containsKey(seasonId) && result.targetFollowStatus != null) {
                (current.seasonDetail.userStatus ?: UserStatus()).copy(
                    follow = 1, followStatus = result.targetFollowStatus
                )
            } else current.seasonDetail.userStatus
            val merged = resolveBangumiMergedFollowStatus(
                seasonId, verifiedStatus, followStatusCache,
                followStatusValueCache, followedSeasonIds
            )
            val status = (current.seasonDetail.userStatus ?: UserStatus()).copy(
                follow = if (merged.isFollowing) 1 else 0,
                followStatus = merged.followStatus
            )
            _uiState.value = current.copy(
                seasonDetail = current.seasonDetail.copy(userStatus = status)
            )

windowsDeviations: currentBangumiFollowSession() (TokenManager mid and SESSDATA) becomes environment.followSession(): the Root supplies the account epoch of the presenter (a Windows presenter belongs to exactly one account epoch and retires when it changes). The policy keeps a constant default session for callers that pass none.
The logged-out test of the background follow verification uses the Root account view hasPrimarySessionCookie() instead of the global session cookie string.

sendEpisodeDanmaku, the server-disabled read and saveCover go through the ordinary video owner (same CSRF, account epoch and accepted native source admission); a changed source reads as closed and never throws to the caller.
